note: Drawing batches (owner, 2026-11-23: small sprites first, large ones on hold). Each batch is a few related items, best drawn on one sketchbook page and sent as one photo, with each code written next to its drawing. npm run art:list makes art/list/batch-<n>.png and the list in art/BATCHES.md.

batches.name: Pickups
batches.why: On every course: stars, the apple, the shot orb, acorns and the Grab Bag.

batches.name: The ball and ability icons
batches.why: The curled-up ball you play as (Rollo, Thud, Pip) and the ten ability icons on the HUD. With the Wild (O23), the random-ability pickup: drawn as a bright crystal with an exclamation mark (drafts in art/drafts/O23-*), finished together with the ability icons (owner, 2026-11-23).

batches.name: Status and enemy markers
batches.why: Little icons over bugs: stunned, burning, poisoned, chilled, shield, the six traits, ranks, the alert and the facing mark.

batches.name: Gear: weapon families
batches.why: Each family is four items from plain to fancy: draw the plain one and how it gets fancier. Needles start from your G13.

batches.name: Gear: armour families
batches.why: Linings, guards, hides and grit gear, four of each from plain to fancy.

batches.name: Gear: bauble families
batches.why: Star, sight, lucky and spinner families, four of each.

batches.name: Gear: one-of-a-kind items
batches.why: Special and legendary gear with their own looks.

batches.name: Map and menu icons
batches.why: Map nodes, run upgrades, permanent upgrades in the Burrow, and the cursor.

batches.name: Small scenery and props
batches.why: Things on the ground: tufts, flowers, pebbles, mushrooms, leaves, bones, fireflies, the barrel, the molehill and the spat seed.

batches.name: Small bugs and grub marks
batches.why: The three smallest bugs, then the ten ability grubs: each is your Snoozegrub in its own colour with a small mark on its shell, so only the mark needs drawing.
